The work spans product analytics, data engineering, GTM analytics, growth, and more. A core part of the role involves building and maintaining data architecture to support reporting, analytics, and experimentation, with longer-term work involving predictive modeling and machine learning to help the broader organization understand and improve customer experiences.
cond_0054.responsibilities:
Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing product instrumentation and help bridge gaps in data streams to support data science initiatives.
Work with the team to analyze product usage patterns and better understand customer behavior including acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention.
Proactively identify user trends and share relevant insights with partners to assist product decision-making.
Coordinate with data and engineering teams to automate and optimize data pipelines using SQL and/or Python-based ETL Frameworks.
Build and maintain various dashboards to keep the team informed about the state of the business, and to alert business partners when issues occur.
Collaborate with product and engineering to architect and implement models that recommend personalized in-app content.
Work alongside product and analytics partners to coordinate A/B and multivariate tests and design feature-level experiments to validate hypotheses and inform product development decisions.
cond_0054.requirements:
MS or Ph.D. In data science, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or economics.
3 - 5+ Years of relevant data science experience.
Experience translating business questions into data analytics approaches.
Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages (Hive, Spark, etc.).
Experience developing and operationalizing consistent approaches to experimentation, using appropriate statistical techniques to reduce bias and interpret statistical significance.
Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics (i.e., t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation, regression, etc.) to understand customer engagement and generate hypotheses.
Experience crafting data visualizations and storytelling to efficiently communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of relevant tools in this field such as Hadoop, Hive, Splunk, Spark, Tableau, Excel (Charting and Pivot-Tables), and Power BI.
Experience in product instrumentation is a plus.
Natural curiosity and technical competence, with the ability to ask critical questions and address challenges as they arise.
Experience addressing an executive level audience.
Excellent communication, relationship skills, and a strong teammate.
